content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is not a workaround. It is base-layer infrastructure. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets (free). Files deliver via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). Payments process through NOWPayments (0.5% fee). You own every component. No platform locks you in. No subscription drains your revenue. This architecture is sovereign. It works in regions where conventional platforms fail. It is built for creators who choose ownership over rent.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The customer lands on your store. They select a product. The price displays in USD but pays in crypto (Bitcoin, USDT, etc.). NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. A webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automates file delivery. The order logs in Supabase or Google Sheets. You retain 99.5% of every sale. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% fee. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more. This system is automated, secure, and yours to control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software. It is for those in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. It is for creators who refuse to be locked out of global commerce. It is for those who choose infrastructure sovereignty over platform dependency.
Retain 99.5% of every sale. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you keep $921 more than Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. Each component is free or low-cost. Each integrates seamlessly. You deploy the stack once. It runs automatically. You own the code. You control the data. You keep the revenue. This is not a platform. It is your infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both deploy in 48 hours. Both include NOWPayments integration. Both load your products and configure your store. Or download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Deploy your stack. Load your products. Start selling. This is not theory. It is tested infrastructure. Built in Zimbabwe. Pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. It works where others fail.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. Host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Process payments with NOWPayments. This architecture is platform-independent. You own every component. It works in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable.
Deploy in 48 hours. No coding required. Own your infrastructure from day one.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or need a digital download store with no platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints for non-developers. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, Ethereum, and more. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON (under $0.10 per transaction).
Do I need to set up a crypto wallet?
Yes. You’ll need a crypto wallet to receive payments. NOWPayments integrates with your wallet address. No buyer account required.
How are files delivered securely?
Files deliver via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Access is automated and secured via signed URLs. Only paying customers receive the download link.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain. If a payment fails, the customer is prompted to try again. No files deliver until payment confirms.
